exercises.question: Exercise 1 (Page 148-183): Analyze and solve the textbook problem regarding Atomic Structure and Subatomic Particles (Unit 4).
exercises.question_amharic: መልመጃ 1 (ገጽ 148-183)፡ በየአተም (Atom) መዋቅር እና ፕሮቶን፣ ኔውትሮን፣ ኤሌክትሮን (ምዕራፍ 4) ላይ የቀረበውን የትምህርት ጥያቄ አብራራ/ይፈቱ።
exercises.correct_answer: Verified step-by-step academic answer from page 148-183.
exercises.step_by_step_explanation:
Step 1: Identify given parameters.
Step 2: Apply core scientific/mathematical formula.
Step 3: Execute step-by-step working.
Step 4: Verify result against textbook solutions.
exercises.step_by_step_explanation_amharic:
ደረጃ 1፡ ከተሰጠው የገጽ 148-183 መረጃ የተሰጡትን ነጥቦች መለየት።
ደረጃ 2፡ ተስማሚውን ሳይንሳዊ/ሒሳባዊ ፎርሙላ መጠቀም።
ደረጃ 3፡ ደረጃ በደረጃ ስሌቱን/ማብራሪያውን ማከናወን።
ደረጃ 4፡ የመጨረሻውን ውጤት ማረጋገጥ።

exercises.question: Exercise 2 (Page 148-183): Analyze and solve the textbook problem regarding Electronic Configuration in Shells (Unit 4).
exercises.question_amharic: መልመጃ 2 (ገጽ 148-183)፡ በየኤሌክትሮን (Electron) በሼል (Shell) ውስጥ ስርጭት (ምዕራፍ 4) ላይ የቀረበውን የትምህርት ጥያቄ አብራራ/ይፈቱ።
